details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 3; an explicit trait, not a bonus calculated from Size.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Tactics and retreat:** Seize a nest intruder only if the shared grapple leaves a useful action choice. It cannot automatically carry a held creature skyward.

**Encounter and conversation:** The party's destination has become nesting material; recovering it requires a distraction larger than a thrown stone.

**Habitat:** Wild frontier; ancient ruin · **Communication:** None

**Loot:** Recoverable possessions or lair clues chosen for the adventure; body parts grant no automatic special equipment or coin value.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.

Use the attributes above for defenses named by incoming attacks. Same targeting, limits and costs apply; no opposed second roll.

### CV worksheet

**Reference damage:** 5/8/12

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.6

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.45 → 1.6: Maneuver allowance +0.05, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=4.596, O=9.044. Uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md). Utility is provisional and does not simulate control, positioning or summon choices.

**Ability sources:** [Bank Away](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/bank-away.md), [seizing limbs](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/seizing-limbs.md), [Wing Step](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/wing-step.md).

**Coverage reference:** [Pathfinder family survey](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/family-survey.md); original HOL prose and mechanics.

# Bank Away

*A struck feather spins loose as the great wings tilt and carry the creature out of the firing line.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-bank-away

**Action:** Reaction

After a ranged attack resolves and deals HP damage to this creature, fly up to 2 squares using its printed fly speed. Pay normal terrain costs, provoke normally and finish in a legal position. This creature must survive and remain capable of flight. No trigger from a free attack; no attack or automatic lift of a held creature.

monsterAbilityTemplates.flavorMarkdown: *A coil or grasping limb closes around the target and braces against its struggling weight.*
monsterAbilityTemplates.rulesMarkdown:
Use the printed attack. Standard also establishes Grappled 1; Strong establishes Grappled 2. A single holder’s contribution is replaced by its higher new result, not added to itself. Other holders stack normally. The holder suffers its own grapple contribution and cannot move while maintaining it. Release at any time without an action; death, unconsciousness or separation beyond the attack’s reach ends the hold. Force and external aid follow the core grapple rules.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed

# Seizing Limbs

*A coil or grasping limb closes around the target and braces against its struggling weight.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-seizing-limbs


**Action:** Main Action

Use the printed attack. Standard also establishes Grappled 1; Strong establishes Grappled 2. A single holder’s contribution is replaced by its higher new result, not added to itself. Other holders stack normally. The holder suffers its own grapple contribution and cannot move while maintaining it. Release at any time without an action; death, unconsciousness or separation beyond the attack’s reach ends the hold. Force and external aid follow the core grapple rules.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.
